title: Every pixel earns its place.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props. Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 aspect (1080x1350), designed for Instagram feed carousels (full frame visible) and TikTok photo carousels. SAFE ZONES: (a) Instagram profile grid crops to CENTER 1:1 — the top ~135px and bottom ~135px are cropped in the grid view, so keep the hero subject center-frame. (b) TikTok photo mode overlays a caption/UI region across the bottom ~340px on the visible feed — keep any critical visual detail above that band. (c) The lower ~40% of the frame (roughly y=810 to y=1350 on a 1080x1350 canvas) is reserved for on-slide type — compose the subject in the upper ~55-60% but fill the ENTIRE frame with natural scene content — NO dark band, NO black rectangle, NO artificial dark area. A CSS gradient handles text legibility. No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Craft story about design attention to detail. Slides 2 and 5 are frameless composites showing the polished booking UI (laptop-hero and laptop-book). Companion to scene-14 and scene-20.

slides.title: Typography is ==not decoration==
slides.body: Font weights guide the eye. Spacing creates hierarchy. The guest reads 'book now' before they read the price — that's not an accident.

slides.title: ==White space== is a feature
slides.body: Every millimeter of breathing room around a button increases tap accuracy on mobile by 12%. We don't add margins because it looks clean — we add them because they convert.
